source_document.title: Trained Leader Requirements - Unit and Other Positions

sources.citation: Scouting America, Trained Leader Requirements - Unit and Other Positions
Scouting America, Position Trained Requirements, June 2025 (lists New Member Coordinator, not Parent Coordinator)
Scouting Wire, New Member Coordinator (states it replaces Unit Membership Chair and Parent Coordinator, which are no longer available)

provenance.notes: Retired: superseded by New Member Coordinator (registration code NM), the unit committee position that Scouting America introduced to replace both Parent Coordinator and Unit Membership Chair. 'Parent Coordinator' appears in neither the June 2025 nor the earlier Position Trained Requirements; both instead carry New Member Coordinator (authored as *-new-member-coordinator).

discontinued.reason: Superseded by New Member Coordinator, the unit committee position Scouting America introduced to replace Parent Coordinator and Unit Membership Chair. Confirmed against the New Member Coordinator materials; the exact retirement date is not published.
